mapper.select:
SELECT v.id AS id, v.sku_code AS skuCode, i.name AS itemName, v.color AS color, v.size AS size, v.status AS status, v.stock AS stock, v.stock_alert_threshold AS stockAlertThreshold, v.price AS price, v.cost_price AS costPrice, v.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, v.material_id AS materialId, m.name AS materialName,
CASE WHEN v.image_filename IS NULL OR v.image_filename = '' THEN NULL ELSE CONCAT('/uploads/', v.image_filename) END AS imageUrl
FROM item_variants v JOIN items i ON i.id = v.item_id LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = v.category_id LEFT JOIN materials m ON m.id = v.material_id
WHERE 1=1
AND (i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR v.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%'))
AND v.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND v.material_id = #{materialId}
AND v.status = #{status}
AND v.stock > 0
AND v.stock = 0
AND v.stock_alert_threshold > 0 AND v.stock <= v.stock_alert_threshold
ORDER BY i.name ASC, v.sku_code ASC
SELECT stock FROM item_variants WHERE id = #{variantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE item_variants SET stock = #{newStock}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{variantId}
UPDATE item_variants SET stock = stock + #{delta}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{variantId} AND stock + #{delta} >= 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_variants (item_id, sku_code, stock, status, price) VALUE (#{itemId},#{skuCode},#{stock},#{status},#{price})
